newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Volume dips, index rises on Estonian bourse.
newsitem.headline: Volume dips, index rises on Estonian bourse.

text.p: Volume dipped slightly on Estonia's bourse on Friday and the index crept up, the Tallinn Stock Exchange said in a statement.
Overall volume was almost 5.5 million kroons compared with almost seven million kroons on Thursday and the index rose by 0.48 percent to 97.00.
Forex Bank was the most active listing with shares worth over 2.3 million kroons traded and it closed at 77.95 kroons compared to 77.60 kroons on Thursday.
Market leader Hansa Bank was also active at 1.33 million krrons and it closed at 93.00 kroons compared with 92.10 kroons on Thursday.
